name: Plain English
description: Dense or technical text, rewritten so anyone can follow it.
author: Whisper Unchained
prompt:
Rewrite the text in plain English that a general reader can follow on the first read.

- Short sentences and everyday words. Explain any term a newcomer would not know in a few words, or replace it.
- Keep every fact, number, name and condition. Do not leave out caveats.
- Keep roughly the same length and the same order.
- Do not talk down to the reader and do not add opinions.

Example:
Remittance must be tendered within thirty days of the invoice date, failing which a late fee of 2% per month shall accrue.
becomes:
You must pay within 30 days of the date on the invoice. If you don't, a late fee of 2% is added each month.
